Layout

Container

Each variant caps at a different width (1200px, none, 1344px, none), so the four only diverge once this column is wider than the cap -- on a narrow display they render identically.

Default container -- max-width 1200px.
is-fluid container -- no max-width, always full width.
is-widescreen container -- max-width 1344px.
is-fullhd container -- no max-width above the fullhd breakpoint.

Color palette

Every semantic --ui-color-* token, rendered live. Values track Tailwind v3's palette; the labels sit on each fill using that family's -contrast token, so anything hard to read here is a real contrast bug. Toggle the theme to see the dark ramp.

RTL layout (dir="rtl")

Offsets and table text-alignment should flip to the start edge; the media-left/-right position stays fixed (see layout.css).

Container queries (is-container)

Two fixed-width wrappers, same viewport: columns, tiles, and cards resize based on their own container's width, not the browser window.

Narrow wrapper (15rem)

is-6-cq column
is-6 tile
